title: Visiting a castle
instructions: Tom ailesiyle bir kaleyi ziyaret ettiği günü anlatıyor. Kalenin yaşına ve olanlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Last month, we visited an old castle in Scotland.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: It was built more than eight hundred years ago.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: We climbed to the top of the tower. There were two hundred steps!

script.speaker: tom
script.text: From the top, we could see the sea and the mountains.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: My little sister was scared because the guide told us a story about a ghost.

questions.feedback: Kale sekiz yüz yıldan daha önce yapıldı.
questions.evidence: It was built more than eight hundred years ago.

options: The guide told a ghost story.
